cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 58% of energy names green

cards.headline: Power & IPPs leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Power & IPPs at +1.10%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -2.09%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.body: Leaders: RUN +10.01%, ENPH +5.29%, SEDG +4.19%, WFRD +3.63%, ARRY +2.15%. Laggards: EOSE -7.72%, PWR -3.62%, ETN -2.43%, GEV -1.83%.
